claim: Measure, without assuming agreement, how recorded geometric visibility decisions change under real denser ephemerides, individual observer coordinates, and controlled terrain-ray refinement.
antiClaims: No claim of flight safety, operational power/radio availability or calibrated success probability.
Refining the same DEM is not independent terrain truth.
Uniform angular stress is not measured terrain error.
Nominal outcome-stratified case selection is exploratory, not an unbiased validation sample.

priorEvidence.selectionHistory: June 21 ROI 1/4 cases were previously selected from a recommendation search. Existing audit is retained as prior exploratory evidence, never retrospectively preregistered.

candidateRule: Every existing site, all nine actual positions, at each 00:00 UTC daily start whose full 168 h lies in that month. No fabricated coordinates or changed constraints.

selectionRules.normal: Complete pass with minimum of three threshold margins >= 2 h; choose largest minimum margin, then chronological/site/point ID.
selectionRules.critical: Complete candidate with absolute smallest threshold margin <= 0.5 h; choose closest to zero, then chronological/site/point ID. If none exists, retain explicit unavailable category.
selectionRules.failure: Complete fail with smallest threshold margin <= -2 h; choose most negative margin, then chronological/site/point ID.
selectionRules.shortWindow: Complete candidate with an interior joint-visible interval > 0 and <= 0.5 h, neither boundary clipped by mission edge; choose shortest interval, then chronological/site/point ID.

outcomeAccounting: Retain all candidate values, selections, empty strata, duplicate identities, fetch failures/retries, nonfinite/missing epochs, mismatched metadata, decision flips and adverse deltas. Unknown is never a pass or unchanged conclusion.

decisionRules.feasibility: Unchanged original <=24 h dark, <=24 h Earth gap, >=24 h joint; no tolerance relaxes these limits.
decisionRules.numericReproductionMeaning: Floating implementation agreement tolerance only, not physical uncertainty.
decisionRules.discrepancyMeaning: Predeclared screening flag equal to the nominal 30-minute sampling interval; not an error bound. Report every delta, including those below the flag.
decisionRules.eventComparison: Report event counts and directed nearest-boundary distances. Do not invent one-to-one matches when events appear/disappear.
decisionRules.scientificGate: Changes in decisions or event topology narrow support to measured cases. Technical completion never implies numerical stability. Missing physical terrain semantics leaves terrain uncertainty unknown.

interventions.samples: every sixth real 5 min sample, same individual observer

interventions.variable: time cadence only relative to own30
radial sampling only relative to dense5
azimuth sampling only relative to dense5

required: Official clone meaning and sign (error field vs absolute elevation)
Metres, MOON_ME DE421 spherical 1737400m reference, exact geotransform
Spatial correlation retained by full official clone raster; no independently sampled pixel noise
Observer ground and occluding terrain both adjusted consistently
Regional fallback uncertainty remains unmodelled and disclosed
terrainProtocol.ensembleMeaning: Fixed sparse diagnostic subset, not a probability estimate or complete 100-member ensemble.
